CREATE TABLE "public"."ActivityEvent" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Appointment" (
  "agentId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'BOOKED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Appointment_status_check_cd6f6c1c" CHECK ("status" IN ('BOOKED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Lead" (
  "aiEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "area" text,
  "assignedToId" text,
  "budgetMax" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "firstResponseAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "intent" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "phone" text,
  "preApproved" bool,
  "score" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "stage" text DEFAULT 'NEW' NOT NULL,
  "tags" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "temperature" text DEFAULT 'COLD' NOT NULL,
  "timelineMonths" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Lead_intent_check_55273370" CHECK ("intent" IN ('BUYER', 'SELLER', 'INVESTOR', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "Lead_source_check_c0a17e31" CHECK ("source" IN ('WEBSITE', 'FACEBOOK', 'ZILLOW', 'GOOGLE_ADS', 'MANUAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "Lead_stage_check_e4cbd60e" CHECK ("stage" IN ('NEW', 'CONTACTED', 'QUALIFIED', 'APPOINTMENT', 'CLOSED_WON', 'CLOSED_LOST')),
  CONSTRAINT "Lead_tags_elem_not_null_aecbe9e2" CHECK (array_position("tags", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Lead_temperature_check_f31e8577" CHECK ("temperature" IN ('HOT', 'WARM', 'COLD'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Message" (
  "author" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text NOT NULL,
  "meta" jsonb,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Message_author_check_baa3fbc4" CHECK ("author" IN ('LEAD', 'AI', 'AGENT', 'SYSTEM')),
  CONSTRAINT "Message_channel_check_e9ea543c" CHECK ("channel" IN ('WEB', 'EMAIL', 'SMS'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Sequence" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "trigger" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SequenceEnrollment" (
  "currentStep" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text NOT NULL,
  "sequenceId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "SequenceEnrollment_status_check_666a942a" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'STOPPED', 'DONE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SequenceStep" (
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "delayMinutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sequenceId" text NOT NULL,
  "template" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "SequenceStep_channel_check_e9ea543c" CHECK ("channel" IN ('WEB', 'EMAIL', 'SMS'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'AGENT' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_8de2d3ca" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'AGENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WebhookEvent" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
